recommended_human_action.summary: HOLD. A Class 3 queue received a document carrying no Class 3 goods, and two blocking fields are absent. Do not process until routing is corrected and the companion documents are obtained.
steps: Confirm which review queue this document belongs in - the entries read are Class 9 and Division 6.2, not Class 3.
Obtain the Air Waybill and any commercial invoice / packing list so cross-document checks can actually run.
Verify line 2 independently against the current IATA DGR: correct UN number for Biological Substance, Category B, and whether a packing group applies to Division 6.2.
Verify line 1 independently: whether a packing group applies to Carbon Dioxide, solid, and the PI 954 requirements.
Obtain a clean re-scan where the aircraft limitation and shipment type deletions are unambiguous.
Ask the shipper to state, in writing, what the second figure in each quantity column represents.
Require a legible signature in the signature block before any acceptance step.
recommended_human_action.required_qualification: Current IATA DGR-trained dangerous goods person
do_not: Do not sign as the certifying shipper.
Do not infer or convert any unit - the litre values must not be converted to kg.
Do not treat agreement between documents, once obtained, as establishing correctness.
